findingClass: a document the pipeline can never reach settles as NOT_YET_FILED and stays there silently forever — NOT_YET_FILED is deliberately not a failure, which is exactly what makes an unreachable document invisible (T-403 B-1: the SEBI rung could never fire for a DRHP)
failThreshold: NOT_YET_FILED past its filing calendar: DRHP >14d from first sight, RHP >2d after open, PROSPECTUS >3d after close (listing is T+3 and a company cannot list before the Prospectus is filed), anchor report >1d after open. A row whose governing date is missing is skipped, never guessed at
